public_api_proposal: Keep ensureGridLayout() with existing unavailable-profile behavior.

Add ensureGridLayout(const GridStartupObservation&) for explicit source/observation-qualified fresh role; can complete an already-owned pending prefix without reallocating, or allocate prefix once then continue.

GridStartupObservation requires nonempty provenance and explicit current-condition observations; no default false/empty inferred. Represent application filters as an ordered typed list with supported WindowsVistaStyle member, not as a callback-success bool. Unsupported additional filter kinds remain guarded.

Current-profile predicates: app present; same-thread parent transfer; zero QInternal type3 callbacks; no object filters; single source-bound WindowsVistaStyle application filter; declarative child-event feature off; no child hook data; observed/source-qualified layout flag state; current manager window flags from follow-up probe.
No second native callback registry is created: these are explicit execution-profile observations for previously recovered pure leaves, not synthetic receiver implementations or notification counters.

Replace single pending bool internally with stage ChildAddedPending,WindowTailPending,Cached (plus fresh state); preserve public pending query as any incomplete stage.
Complete qualified source-closed internal/app/object/receiver path and disabled post-parent hooks. Do not invoke an invented no-op function.

Unknown or true-window extra/sizehint path stays at exact WindowTailPending guard. A retry does not repeat allocation, parent ownership, notification or already applied invalidate.
